name: ArrayList add, get, size
desc: A resizable array. add appends, get reads by index in constant time, and contains uses equals.

name: ArrayList removeIf
desc: Removes every element that matches the predicate in one pass. It is safer than removing inside a for each loop.

name: HashMap getOrDefault
desc: Returns the mapped value or the fallback when the key is absent. It removes the null check after get.

name: HashMap computeIfAbsent
desc: Creates and stores a value only when the key is missing, then returns it. It removes the get, null check, put sequence.

name: HashSet add and contains
desc: Stores unique values with no order. add returns false when the value was already present, which makes it a duplicate check.

name: TreeMap sorted keys
desc: A map that keeps its keys sorted. firstKey, lastKey, and headMap come from that order and HashMap cannot offer them.

name: List.sort
desc: Sorts the list in place. It works on any List, including ArrayList, and replaces Collections.sort for lists.

name: Comparator.comparing
desc: Builds a comparator from a key extractor. Chain thenComparing for a second key and reversed for descending order.

name: Stream filter and map
desc: Builds a pipeline: filter keeps matching items, map transforms them, and toList collects the result.

name: Collectors.groupingBy
desc: Collects items into a Map keyed by the classifier result. A second collector can count or sum within each group.

name: Collectors.joining
desc: Joins stream elements into one string with a delimiter, plus optional prefix and suffix. Elements must already be strings.

name: Optional map and orElse
desc: Represents a value that may be missing. map transforms only when present, orElse supplies the fallback.

name: StringBuilder
desc: Builds a string with mutable buffers. Concatenation in a loop creates a new String each time, append does not.

name: Files.readString
desc: Reads a whole file into one String as UTF-8. It is the shortest option for configuration and small data files.

name: Files.readAllLines
desc: Reads a file into a List of lines with the line breaks removed. Convenient for CSV or log files that fit in memory.

name: Files.writeString
desc: Writes a String to a file in one call, creating or truncating the file. Options add append and create behaviour.

name: BufferedReader readLine
desc: Reads a file line by line with a buffer. It returns null at the end and does not hold the whole file in memory.

name: BufferedWriter newLine
desc: Writes text line by line with a buffer. newLine uses the platform separator, unlike a hardcoded backslash n.

name: Path.resolve
desc: Joins path parts without string concatenation. resolve returns the second path when it is absolute, and normalize removes dot segments.

name: Files.walk
desc: Streams every path below a directory. The stream holds an open directory handle, so close it with try with resources.

name: LocalDate parse and plusDays
desc: A date without time or zone. parse expects ISO format, plusDays and ChronoUnit handle date arithmetic.

name: DateTimeFormatter
desc: Formats and parses dates with a pattern. Store the formatter in a static field because it is immutable and thread safe.

name: try with resources
desc: Closes every resource that implements AutoCloseable, in reverse order, even when the body throws. It replaces the finally block.

name: record
syntax: public record Hotel(String name, int stars) {}
desc: A compact immutable data class. The compiler generates the constructor, accessors, equals, hashCode, and toString.
